mapper.select: SELECT g.* FROM groups g JOIN group_members m ON m.group_id = g.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO groups (id, name, avatar, description, owner_user_id, status, created_at, dissolved_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{description}, #{ownerUserId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{dissolvedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE groups SET name = #{name}, avatar = #{avatar}, description = #{description}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, status = #{status}, dissolved_at = #{dissolvedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM group_members WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM group_members WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY joined_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_members (group_id, user_id, role, status, joined_at, left_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{joinedAt}, #{leftAt}) ON CONFLICT (group_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = EXCLUDED.role, status = EXCLUDED.status, joined_at = EXCLUDED.joined_at, left_at = EXCLUDED.left_at
mapper.update: UPDATE group_members SET role = #{role}, status = #{status}, joined_at = #{joinedAt}, left_at = #{leftAt} WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE group_members SET status = 'REMOVED', left_at = #{leftAt} WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invitations (id, group_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, status, created_at, accepted_at, revoked_at, invalidated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{acceptedAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{invalidatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE invitations SET status = #{status}, accepted_at = #{acceptedAt}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, invalidated_at = #{invalidatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM invitations WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND inviter_id = #{inviterId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE invitations SET status = 'INVALIDATED', invalidated_at = #{invalidatedAt} WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'PENDING'
